import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    inbound = inputs["inbound"]
    target_snapshot = inputs["target_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: STG_NEW
    filtered = inbound[inbound["qty"] > 0]

    stg_new = (
        filtered.groupby(["product_id", "batch_date"], dropna=False, as_index=False)
        .agg(total_qty=("qty", "sum"), max_unit_cost=("unit_cost", "max"))
    )

    # Ensure column order
    stg_new = stg_new[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]]

    # Step 2: DELETE FROM TARGET_SNAPSHOT WHERE batch_date IN (distinct batch_dates of STG_NEW)
    arriving_dates = pd.Series(stg_new["batch_date"].unique())

    if len(arriving_dates) > 0:
        # Keep rows whose batch_date is NOT in arriving_dates
        # Handle NaN matching semantics consistent with SQL IN (NULLs don't match in SQL IN)
        non_null_dates = arriving_dates[arriving_dates.notna()]
        mask_delete = target_snapshot["batch_date"].isin(non_null_dates)
        survivors = target_snapshot[~mask_delete]
    else:
        survivors = target_snapshot.copy()

    # Step 3: INSERT INTO TARGET_SNAPSHOT SELECT * FROM STG_NEW
    result = pd.concat([survivors, stg_new], ignore_index=True)

    return {"target_snapshot": result}
